title: ProjectWorkFeature
responsibility: Render one feature work plan and its module task tree.

inputs.name: ProjectWorkFeature.feature
inputs.description: The selected feature, its plan and projected task progress from the project queue.

inputs.name: ProjectWorkFeature.initiallyOpen
inputs.description: Whether the feature row is expanded when first rendered; later refreshes preserve the user selection.

outputs.name: ProjectWorkFeature
outputs.description: Accessible nested feature, module, wanted-contract and design-option metadata; actual stored task status labels and blockers, with planned but unsubmitted tasks distinctly labeled. User-expanded and collapsed feature rows remain in their chosen state as the selected project queue refreshes, including when a later queue commit changes task status.
